headline: 把真实机器人任务搬进仿真
title_en: RoboSimStudio: Rebuild Real Robot Tasks in Simulation
tagline_en: An open toolkit that turns a video or a sentence into an interactive physics simulation of a robot task.
summary_md:
**What it is:** RoboSimStudio is an open-source toolkit (Apache-2.0) for rebuilding real robot manipulation tasks in simulation. You can do it by hand or by prompting a coding agent like Codex or Claude Code. You give it a video (human, ego-centric, or robot), a task instruction, and a robot URDF file, and it helps you construct a physics-based scene that you can interact with. It is inspired by and built on Newton, Warp, MuJoCo Warp, and others, per the README.

**Why it matters:** Real2Sim is a hot direction: if you can faithfully recreate a real task in simulation, you can train and test policies without wearing out hardware or risking damage. RoboSimStudio emphasizes interactivity and human-in-the-loop correction, which is practical because fully automatic reconstruction often gets physics wrong.

**Can you try it without a robot?** Yes, the README says it runs on CPU-only machines and points to an installation guide and examples. The caveat: the full stack (Newton, Warp, MuJoCo Warp) may be heavy for a 16GB Mac, and the README is more news-style than benchmarked, so treat performance claims as unverified. Start with the small examples, then try a phone video reconstruction.

top.title: nvidia/MotionBricks
top.one_liner: 给几个目标姿势，实时生成人形机器人的过渡动作
top.one_liner_en: Generates real-time motion for humanoid robots by connecting given poses.
top.how_to_try: 官方 demo 需要 NVIDIA GPU 和 TensorRT，Mac 跑不动；可以读 GitHub 的 ONNX 导出工具，再查看项目页视频，理解原理
top.how_to_try_en: Official demo needs NVIDIA GPU + TensorRT; on Mac just read the ONNX export tools and watch project-page videos.
top.reason: 大厂开放人形动作生成权重，学习价值高，但 Mac 上只能借助 ONNX 离线尝试，实机演示依赖 NVIDIA 显卡
red_flags: 无硬件不等于能直接运行：官方 demo 强依赖 NVIDIA GPU/TensorRT
只给动作，不给控制器，上真机还需安全校验
训练数据和训练流程未公开，只有推理权重

top.title: lerobot/FineART
top.one_liner: 带逐步语言标注的双手操作机器人数据集，含4万条轨迹。
top.one_liner_en: A bimanual robot dataset with step-by-step language labels, 40k episodes.
top.how_to_try: 在 Mac 上 pip 装 LeRobot，流式加载该数据集，看帧与子任务标注，试写小模型。
top.how_to_try_en: pip install lerobot on your Mac, stream the dataset, inspect frames and subtask labels, then try a tiny model.
top.reason: 开放程度高、标注密集，是学习 VLA 与分层策略的好材料；但整库很难在 Mac 上完整训练，wow 感一般。
red_flags: README 里有一个 TODO 占位链接，模型、代码的入口可能不完整
数据量大（185M 帧），新人很难完整下载，只能抽样或流式读取
所有数据都来自同一种机器人 Trossen，跨本体泛化有限
发布日期写的是 2026-10-12，比较可疑

top.title: CaPtain: A Pipeline for Post-Training Code-as-Policy Robot Agents
top.one_liner: 把机器人操作写成代码，用小模型训练出会写代码的机器人智能体
top.one_liner_en: Trains a small open VLM to control robots by writing code, reaching 73.8% on LIBERO.
top.how_to_try: 在 LIBERO 仿真里跑它的代码；Mac 可跑 4B 模型推理，训练需云 GPU
top.how_to_try_en: Run it in LIBERO sim; 4B inference fits a Mac, training needs cloud GPU.
top.reason: 开源完整含权重数据，思路清晰，适合学 VLA 与多轮 RL；但真实硬件门槛和部分声明待核实。
red_flags: 摘要称用了 GPT-6 Astra 生成数据，具体细节需核实
真实机器人实验需要仿真适配，无硬件者难以复现

top.title: lerobot/smolvla_base
top.one_liner: 一个能在单张显卡上训练的小型视觉-语言-动作机器人模型
top.one_liner_en: A tiny vision-language-action robot model trainable on a single GPU
top.how_to_try: 用 pip 装 lerobot[smolvla]，在 Mac 上加载模型和 libero 数据集跑 select_action，训练还是得云 GPU
top.how_to_try_en: pip install lerobot[smolvla], load the model and libero dataset on Mac to run select_action; training needs cloud GPU
top.reason: 高下载高点赞的入门级开源 VLA，代码权重全开放，是学 VLA 概念的好材料；但 Mac 只能推理，讲的时候要强调这一点。
red_flags: README 是通用模板，没有展示 smolvla 的实测效果
没有 NVIDIA 卡，训练基本不可行，只能做推理
